name: Tamarind Paste
siboNotes: Generally well-tolerated in small amounts due to its concentrated nature and typical usage as a flavoring agent.
preparationTips: Start with small amounts (1 teaspoon) to test tolerance
Mix with water to create tamarind water for cooking
Store in refrigerator after opening to maintain freshness
Use as a souring agent in curries and sauces
nutritionalHighlights: Rich in vitamin C and antioxidants
